mapper.sql: CASE #{query.dimension} WHEN 'CUSTOMER' THEN so.customer_id WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN soi.sku_id WHEN 'CATEGORY' THEN cat.id WHEN 'SELLER' THEN so.seller_id WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN w.id ELSE NULL::BIGINT END AS dimension_id, CASE #{query.dimension} WHEN 'CUSTOMER' THEN so.customer_name_snapshot WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN soi.product_name_snapshot WHEN 'CATEGORY' THEN COALESCE(cat.name, '未分类') WHEN 'SELLER' THEN COALESCE(e.actual_name, '未分配销售员') WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN COALESCE(w.name, '未归属仓库') ELSE TO_CHAR((fact_event.event_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS dimension_name, CASE #{query.dimension} WHEN 'CUSTOMER' THEN so.customer_code_snapshot WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN soi.sku_code_snapshot WHEN 'CATEGORY' THEN CAST(cat.id AS VARCHAR) WHEN 'SELLER' THEN CAST(so.seller_id AS VARCHAR) WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN w.warehouse_code ELSE NULL::VARCHAR END AS dimension_code, CASE WHEN #{query.dimension} = 'DAY' THEN (fact_event.event_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date ELSE NULL::DATE END AS biz_date

JOIN customer c ON c.id = so.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = so.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_spu ps ON ps.id = soi.spu_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_category cat ON cat.id = ps.category_id AND cat.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_category cat2 ON cat2.id = cat.parent_id AND cat2.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_category cat3 ON cat3.id = cat2.parent_id AND cat3.deleted = FALSE

sql.if: AND (so.order_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR so.customer_name_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR soi.product_name_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR soi.sku_code_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR soi.spu_code_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(w.name, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql:
WITH return_allocations AS ( SELECT receipt_item.return_item_id, receipt_item.source_sales_out_movement_id, SUM(receipt_item.quantity) AS allocated_quantity FROM order_return_receipt_item receipt_item GROUP BY receipt_item.return_item_id, receipt_item.source_sales_out_movement_id ), return_allocation_totals AS ( SELECT return_item_id, SUM(allocated_quantity) AS allocated_quantity FROM return_allocations GROUP BY return_item_id ), facts AS ( -- Revenue is recognized from NORMAL Finance receivables at their event time. SELECT , receivable_item.amount AS revenue_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, CASE WHEN sales_out.id IS NULL OR sales_out.unit_cost IS NULL THEN 1::BIGINT ELSE 0::BIGINT END AS cost_missing_count FROM finance_receivable receivable JOIN finance_receivable_item receivable_item ON receivable_item.receivable_id = receivable.id AND receivable_item.deleted = FALSE AND receivable_item.source_type = 'INVENTORY_OUTBOUND_ITEM' JOIN inventory_outbound_item outbound_item ON outbound_item.id = receivable_item.source_id AND outbound_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN inventory_outbound outbound ON outbound.id = outbound_item.outbound_id AND outbound.deleted = FALSE JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = receivable.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = receivable_item.order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receivable.event_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN inventory_movement sales_out ON sales_out.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND sales_out.source_document_item_id = outbound_item.id AND sales_out.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND sales_out.warehouse_id = outbound.warehouse_id AND sales_out.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = outbound.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE receivable.deleted = FALSE AND receivable.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND receivable.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND receivable.event_at >= #{startAt} AND receivable.event_at < #{endAt} AND outbound_item.sales_order_id = so.id AND outbound_item.sales_order_item_id = soi.id
UNION ALL
-- Approved red receivables reverse revenue. Allocate it only across physically received -- quantities with a traceable original outbound; the not-yet-received remainder is -- unassigned to a warehouse and is visible only to an all-warehouse scope. SELECT , -receivable_item.amount * allocation.allocated_quantity / NULLIF(return_item.approved_quantity, 0) AS revenue_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, 0::BIGINT AS cost_missing_count FROM finance_receivable receivable JOIN finance_receivable_item receivable_item ON receivable_item.receivable_id = receivable.id AND receivable_item.deleted = FALSE AND receivable_item.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN_ITEM' JOIN order_return_item return_item ON return_item.id = receivable_item.source_id AND return_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN return_allocations allocation ON allocation.return_item_id = return_item.id JOIN inventory_movement source_sales_out ON source_sales_out.id = allocation.source_sales_out_movement_id AND source_sales_out.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND source_sales_out.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND source_sales_out.deleted = FALSE JOIN inventory_outbound_item outbound_item ON outbound_item.id = source_sales_out.source_document_item_id AND outbound_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = receivable.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = return_item.order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receivable.event_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = source_sales_out.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE receivable.deleted = FALSE AND receivable.entry_type = 'RED' AND receivable.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN' AND receivable.event_at >= #{startAt} AND receivable.event_at < #{endAt} AND outbound_item.sales_order_item_id = soi.id AND outbound_item.sales_order_id = so.id
UNION ALL
-- Red revenue that has not yet been physically allocated to a source outbound. SELECT , -receivable_item.amount * CASE WHEN return_item.approved_quantity > 0 THEN GREATEST(return_item.approved_quantity - COALESCE(allocation_totals.allocated_quantity, 0), 0) / return_item.approved_quantity ELSE 1 END AS revenue_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, 0::BIGINT AS cost_missing_count FROM finance_receivable receivable JOIN finance_receivable_item receivable_item ON receivable_item.receivable_id = receivable.id AND receivable_item.deleted = FALSE AND receivable_item.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN_ITEM' JOIN order_return_item return_item ON return_item.id = receivable_item.source_id AND return_item.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN return_allocation_totals allocation_totals ON allocation_totals.return_item_id = return_item.id JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = receivable.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = return_item.order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receivable.event_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON FALSE
WHERE receivable.deleted = FALSE AND receivable.entry_type = 'RED' AND receivable.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN' AND receivable.event_at >= #{startAt} AND receivable.event_at < #{endAt} AND (return_item.approved_quantity IS NULL OR return_item.approved_quantity > COALESCE(allocation_totals.allocated_quantity, 0))
AND FALSE
UNION ALL
-- COGS is taken from the immutable SALES_OUT movement at its own occurrence time. SELECT , 0::NUMERIC AS revenue_amount, COALESCE(sales_out.quantity * sales_out.unit_cost, 0) AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, CASE WHEN sales_out.unit_cost IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM finance_receivable receivable JOIN finance_receivable_item receivable_item ON receivable_item.receivable_id = receivable.id AND receivable_item.deleted = FALSE AND receivable_item.source_type = 'INVENTORY_OUTBOUND_ITEM' WHERE receivable.deleted = FALSE AND receivable.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND receivable.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND receivable_item.source_id = outbound_item.id AND receivable.event_at >= #{startAt} AND receivable.event_at < #{endAt} ) THEN 1::BIGINT ELSE 0::BIGINT END AS cost_missing_count FROM inventory_movement sales_out JOIN inventory_outbound_item outbound_item ON outbound_item.id = sales_out.source_document_item_id AND outbound_item.deleted = FALSE AND outbound_item.sales_order_id IS NOT NULL AND outbound_item.sales_order_item_id IS NOT NULL JOIN inventory_outbound outbound ON outbound.id = outbound_item.outbound_id AND outbound.deleted = FALSE AND outbound.warehouse_id = sales_out.warehouse_id JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = outbound_item.sales_order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = outbound_item.sales_order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sales_out.occurred_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = sales_out.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE sales_out.deleted = FALSE AND sales_out.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND sales_out.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND sales_out.occurred_at >= #{startAt} AND sales_out.occurred_at < #{endAt}
UNION ALL
-- Physical acceptance reverses original sales cost per ADR-006; disposition only -- decides whether the returned quantity becomes available inventory. SELECT , 0::NUMERIC AS revenue_amount, -(receipt_item.quantity * receipt_item.unit_cost) AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, 0::BIGINT AS cost_missing_count FROM order_return_receipt_item receipt_item JOIN order_return_receipt return_receipt ON return_receipt.id = receipt_item.receipt_id JOIN order_return return_doc ON return_doc.id = return_receipt.return_id JOIN order_return_item return_item ON return_item.id = receipt_item.return_item_id AND return_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN inventory_movement source_sales_out ON source_sales_out.id = receipt_item.source_sales_out_movement_id AND source_sales_out.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND source_sales_out.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND source_sales_out.deleted = FALSE JOIN inventory_outbound_item outbound_item ON outbound_item.id = source_sales_out.source_document_item_id AND outbound_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = return_doc.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = return_item.order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT return_receipt.received_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = source_sales_out.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE return_receipt.received_at >= #{startAt} AND return_receipt.received_at < #{endAt} AND outbound_item.sales_order_item_id = soi.id AND outbound_item.sales_order_id = so.id
UNION ALL
-- 促销赠品成本：赠品**不减收入**，但它的出库成本计入该订单的履约成本（ADR-009）。 -- 单独一列 gift_cost_amount 而不是并进 sales_cost_amount：「这个月活动送掉多少成本」 -- 要能直接从报表回答，而不是回头从库存流水重拼一遍。 -- 商品 / 分类维度按**赠品 SKU** 归集（下面那张派生表把赠品对成 soi 的形状）， -- 因此该 SKU 会呈现为「有成本、无收入」——那是赠品的事实，不是数据错误。 SELECT , 0::NUMERIC AS revenue_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS sales_cost_amount, COALESCE(gift_out.quantity * gift_out.unit_cost, 0) AS gift_cost_amount, CASE WHEN gift_out.unit_cost IS NULL THEN 1::BIGINT ELSE 0::BIGINT END AS cost_missing_count FROM inventory_movement gift_out JOIN order_promotion_gift gift ON gift.id = gift_out.source_document_item_id JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = gift.sales_order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN ( SELECT sku.id AS id, sku.id AS sku_id, spu.id AS spu_id, spu.spu_code AS spu_code_snapshot, spu.name AS product_name_snapshot, sku.sku_code AS sku_code_snapshot FROM product_sku sku JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id ) soi ON soi.id = gift.sku_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT gift_out.occurred_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = gift_out.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE gift_out.deleted = FALSE AND gift_out.source_document_type = 'ORDER_PROMOTION_GIFT' AND gift_out.movement_type = 'PROMOTION_GIFT_OUT' AND gift_out.occurred_at >= #{startAt} AND gift_out.occurred_at < #{endAt}
)
mapper.select: SELECT dimension_id AS dimensionId, MAX(dimension_name) AS dimensionName, MAX(dimension_code) AS dimensionCode, biz_date AS bizDate, COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) AS revenueAmount, COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) AS salesCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) AS giftCostAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) END AS grossProfit, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(revenue_amount) - SUM(sales_cost_amount) - SUM(gift_cost_amount)) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) * 100, 4) END AS grossMarginRate, SUM(cost_missing_count) AS costMissingCount FROM facts GROUP BY dimension_id, biz_date ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{query.dimension} = 'DAY' THEN biz_date END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN #{query.dimension} <> 'DAY' THEN CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(revenue_amount) - SUM(sales_cost_amount) - SUM(gift_cost_amount) END END DESC NULLS LAST, SUM(revenue_amount) DESC NULLS LAST, MAX(dimension_name)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) AS revenueAmount, COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) AS salesCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) AS giftCostAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) END AS grossProfit, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(revenue_amount) - SUM(sales_cost_amount) - SUM(gift_cost_amount)) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) * 100, 4) END AS grossMarginRate, COALESCE(SUM(cost_missing_count), 0) AS costMissingCount FROM facts
